# Estiqo

> An iPhone app that keeps every number, document, contact and key date for
> Australian investment properties in one private hub, with a one-tap
> accountant-ready EOFY export. On the App Store since 8 September 2026.

App Store (Australia): https://apps.apple.com/au/app/estiqo-investment-property/id6801718917

Estiqo is built specifically for Australia rather than localised into it: the
July–June financial year, the ATO's rental expense categories, and stamp duty
calculated per state.

It is built with no user accounts, no server and no analytics of any kind.
Data is stored locally on the device using SwiftData. There is no cloud sync in
version 1.0. The App Store privacy label reads "Data Not Collected" in every
category.

## Facts

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.0 or later. iPad support planned, not shipped.
- Price: every property is free, forever, with no limit on how many and no
  trial period. Premium is an optional in-app purchase — A$59.99/year or
  A$149.99 once.
- Premium unlocks: EOFY export packs, depreciation schedule, CGT sale
  worksheet, cash flow forecast, value over time, equity and borrowing
  snapshot, portfolio analytics, the "What if?" rate-rise and rent simulator,
  improvement projects, due diligence checklists and calculators.
- Free tier includes: unlimited properties, cash flow, income and expenses,
  documents, receipts and photos, leases, loans, contacts, key dates, Face ID
  lock and one-tap backup export.
- Estiqo is a record-keeping tool. It does not provide financial, tax or legal
  advice, and it does not connect to any bank, broker or financial institution.
- Made in Australia by Adam Garing, sole trader, ABN 61 426 672 740.
